meta.title: Small, private-by-default software for the Mac
meta.description: We build tools that keep your data on your device and leave you with files you own.

hero.description: We build tools that keep your data on your device and leave you with files you own.

principles.title: What we believe
principles.description: Four rules every MonoOne product follows. No exceptions, no fine print.

localFirst.title: Local-first
localFirst.description: Your data stays on your device. Everything core works offline and without an account.

ownFiles.title: Files you own
ownFiles.description: Plain Markdown on disk. No proprietary formats, no lock-in, no export ritual.

private.title: Private by default
private.description: Cloud features are opt-in and redacted. Sharing is end-to-end encrypted.

mac.title: Made for the Mac
mac.description: Native, signed and notarized. Apple Silicon and Intel, macOS 13.4 or later.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: One focused product, built carefully. More when it's ready.

indexOne.tagline: Secure, 100% local meeting notes for macOS.
indexOne.description: IndexOne records your calls, transcribes them and writes a structured note you own as plain Markdown, all on your Mac. Recordings, transcripts and notes stay 100% on your device: no account and no cloud processing. Your library sits in an encrypted database, and nothing is sent anywhere unless you explicitly choose to.

bothSides.title: Both sides of the call
bothSides.description: Your mic and the other side, merged into one clear transcript.

whisper.title: On-device Whisper
whisper.description: Transcription runs locally with Metal. No cloud transcription.

notes.title: Notes you own
notes.description: Summary, decisions and action items as Markdown in your Obsidian vault.

answers.title: Answers with sources
answers.description: Ask mid-call or months later and see which meetings each answer came from.

encrypted.title: Encrypted and lockable
encrypted.description: One encrypted database on your Mac, plus per-folder Touch ID locks.

ai.title: Your AI, your choice
ai.description: On-device model or opt-in cloud. A local MCP server for your own agents.

contact.title: Found a bug or have an idea?
contact.description: We build in the open. Issues and discussions live on GitHub.
